purpose: Retrospection versus repair plans; existing-code/error diagnosis versus prescribed copyable code. No completion/progress/search substitute.
native_tokenizer: tokenizers.Tokenizer.from_file pinned tokenizer.json; normalizer/postprocessor/native IDs verified; no wrapper reconstruction, hypotheses/chat prefixes, clipping, chunk voting or evidence omission
new_fit_does_not_release_holds: All 94 real holds remain, including packet-origin hold on the2454-token case. Prepared split JSONL bytes are IDENTICAL across Ettin68 and the2048-token comparator.
architecture: One fully trainable shared AutoModel encoder without MLM head; native attention-mask mean pooling including CLS/SEP, excluding padding; two independently initialized biased Linear(512,2) heads. Only the appropriate head computes loss per example.

batch.dynamic_padding: Full individual native input only; no length cap. Final short accumulated batch divides by its actual sample count.
batch.sampler: One seeded shuffle of all arm training IDs per epoch, each exactly once; no class/length/score sampling or replacement.

optimizer.schedule: Linear decay; warmup_steps=ceil(0.10*total_optimizer_steps), total_optimizer_steps=5*ceil(training_rows/16). Step scheduler only after an optimizer update.

loss: Cross entropy. Within each real TRAIN fold/arm, weight each real example by N_real/(K*n_task_family), where K counts nonempty real task/family strata; average real loss weight is1. Synthetic examples retain weight1, so the11seed rows do NOT become equal-weight new task families. No within-head class weighting, resampling, UNKNOWN targets or teacher/annotation features. All weighting is training-metadata-only, never based on labels/predictions.
precision: FP32 master parameters/Adam states, BF16 autocast; eager attention explicitly, whole-layer gradient checkpointing, torch.compile disabled; no FlashAttention dependency or implicit kernel substitution.
fitting: For each arm/seed fit3whole-TRAIN-task exclusion folds across BOTH heads/shared encoder, then1final fit on allTRAIN. Standalone train-only synthetic groups may enter mixed arm fits, never calibration labels. 24sequential fits total; noDEV/EVAL fitting or seed selection.
calibration: Per head and arm/seed, pool only real OOF logits; choose temperature by minimum TASK-MACRO OOF NLL over grid[0.25,0.5,1,2,4,8], each original task equally weighted; ties choose temperature nearest1then lower. Report pooled AND task-macro reliability/Brier and risk/coverage at confidence cuts[0.5,0.6,0.7,0.8,0.9,0.95,0.975,0.99]. No approved deployment threshold or diagnostic/fresh-eval tuning.
report: All seeds/arms, not best run. Per-head confusion/missedPLAN/missedDICTATES/false blocks, per-task averages and pooled counts, class/slice/length/harness/language support, NO_FIT/runtime/missing evidence coverage. 20-case archived challenge remains subset of93diagnostics. Unscored94holds remain visible; no correctness credit for excluding hard ambiguity.
deployment_scope: Shared encoder is an experimental sharing choice, not evidence of no negative transfer. Separate specialist comparison or broader backbone selection requires a separately frozen follow-up; deploying multiple encoders must pass the combined budget. No runtime authority from this recipe.
execution_readiness: Data, recipe and CPU-only constructor compatibility frozen/checked. Actual trainer/export implementation, verified pretrained checkpoint and measured GPU/serving parity remain unvalidated. No runnable trainer or measured training peak is claimed.
permission_gate: Operator must separately authorize training and separately clear/hand over RTX3090. No automatic workload kill, GPU allocation, model swap, campaign launch, live hooks or service/config changes.

environment.proposed_gpu_build: torch2.8.0 CUDA12.8 build, same transformers5.20.2/tokenizers0.23.3; dependency/driver compatibility must be validated separately after authorization; not installed or exercised here

checkpoint_loading: Verify published full-file SHA first; official AutoModel, trust_remote_code=False, weights_only=True. All encoder keys/shapes must load; only documented unused MLM head/decoder keys are expected. Never ignore missing encoder weights or mismatched sizes.
serving_candidate_rule: Comparison replicates are NOT an ensemble. Primary proposed serving candidate is the prespecified real-only joint model at seed17, subject to fresh evaluation and explicit admission; no best-seed selection using held-out scores. Other arms/seeds are reported comparisons, not silently additional required serving backbones. Any changed choice is a separately frozen follow-up.
policy_change_rule: Any policy/meaning revision requires a new version and review of affected labels/reservations before inference, not silent recoding of held cases.
randomness_contract: Each fit independently resets Python/Torch/CUDA RNGs to the stated seed. Reset Torch RNG once immediately before constructing both new heads in fixed[retrospective,dictation]order; checkpoint encoder weights must load, not be random. For shuffling, one Python random.Random(seed) per fit persists across epochs; shuffle a fresh sorted-ID list each epoch. Save RNG states and actual batch/optimizer-step receipts. Require deterministic algorithms, disable CuDNN benchmarking; an unsupported deterministic operation stops the arm instead of silently changing engines or precision.
